prompt.generated_prompt_string: Flash-lit rainy-night street-fashion portrait of an adult woman on a neon city street. She wears a pink satin track jacket, black fitted top, white skirt layered over opaque cycling shorts, white socks, and black ankle boots. She turns back over her shoulder with a friendly smile while traffic and Chinese neon signs blur behind her on the wet road. Use direct smartphone flash, realistic skin texture, sharp subject focus, colorful bokeh, natural grain, and a playful urban fashion mood. No text, logos, or watermark.
